002: “Phew… They’re actually letting me assist with such a long operation today. This will go on my internship evaluation too, right?”
“Phew—finally my turn on a long case! I’ve heard about them so often on the ward, but it feels different when it’s your turn.”
004: “You’ve assisted with long cases like this before, haven’t you? I memorized the procedure yesterday, but I still feel unsure.”
“Do you often assist with operations this long? I’d like to see how an experienced nurse paces herself.”
006: “Wonderful! Then I’ll make sure to learn everything I can from you today!”
“Then I’ll be watching closely and stealing your tricks today!”
011: “The ties on these scrub trousers are different from the ones I usually wear. I’ll be standing so long today, I’d better tie them securely.”
012: “Yes. You’ll be standing for a long time. Get your clothes comfortable now, before you’re too busy to think about it.”
019: “You don’t necessarily run into this on short cases. Today’s a long one, so it’s best to think ahead for your own clothes.”
024: “B-blood can get on our underwear?! That wasn’t in the internship handbook!”
“Wait, even our own underwear can get blood on it?! Don’t make it sound like an everyday occurrence!”
029: “Are you… trying to scare the intern on purpose!”
“You’re definitely picking out all the scariest parts to tell me!”
035: “Ooh… You really are making fun of me…”
“You just want to see me embarrass myself, don’t you?”
037: “…All right, I’ll change now. I don’t want to slip up over something like this today.”
“Fine, I’ll change! I’m not sacrificing my favorite underwear.”
046: “I thought I was just terrible at adapting… Does it really not bother you at all?”
“I’m not imagining this, am I? Don’t you think this fabric is really rough?”
063: “Can you… really bring something like this straight to the director?”
“You even know which batch of clothes has problems?”
069: “Come to think of it, didn’t you say you were still settling in at Hoshimi too?”
“You’re always saying you count as a newcomer at Hoshimi. You certainly don’t sound like one.”
077: “If I get so nervous I start fumbling… will that go on my internship evaluation?”
“If I really do get nervous at the table, you’ll give me a reminder, won’t you?”
081: “Why are you bringing that up again!”
